purpose: GeodesicSlicer is a 3D Slicer scripted module extension that calculates geodesic paths on 3D anatomical meshes, draws the EEG 10-20 electrode positioning system, projects scalp stimulation sites, and corrects rTMS resting motor thresholds.
summary: GeodesicSlicer is a well-structured 3D Slicer extension for computing geodesic paths, generating the 10-20 EEG system on scalp models, projecting stimulation targets, and adjusting rTMS motor thresholds. Source code inspection reveals clean Slicer scripted module conventions, valid build configuration, proper CeCILL licensing, and no security or environment concerns. 🟢 Recommend merge

safety.rationale: Inspected GeodesicSlicer/GeodesicSlicer.py. No unsafe operations, network requests, telemetry, data transmission, or command injections found. Uses standard VTK and Slicer MRML/segmentation APIs.

environment.rationale: Inspected CMakeLists.txt and GeodesicSlicer.py. The extension uses standard Slicer extension macros, does not alter Slicer shared environment or python sys.path, and does not install any packages at startup or import time.

packaging.rationale: Inspected top-level CMakeLists.txt and GeodesicSlicer/CMakeLists.txt. Python scripts and icons are correctly included and built via slicerMacroBuildScriptedModule.

license.rationale: Inspected LICENSE and LICENCE files, which contain the standard CeCILL v2.1 open-source license text permitting distribution and modification.

soundness.rationale: Inspected GeodesicSlicer.py. Follows ScriptedLoadableModule conventions, validates input nodes, uses progress dialogs, and correctly wraps algorithmic routines in module logic.

utility.rationale: The extension provides documented tools for neuro-navigation and EEG 10-20 placement with proper disclaimer notices and citations to published literature.
